warnings: WRF RRTM LONGWAVE IS BITWISE AGAINST WRF ON ITS COLUMN ORACLE. gpuwm/core/rrtm_lw.py, gpuwm/core/rrtm_taumol.py and gpuwm/core/rrtm_tables.py transcribe phys/module_ra_rrtm.F (O3DATA, MM5ATM, SETCOEF, CMBGB1-16, TAUGB1-16, GASABS, RTRN, RRTM/RRTMLWRAD) and the coefficient tables are the packaged RRTM_DATA records reduced 256 g-points to 140 by the module's own CMBGB weighting. tools/rrtm_lw_wrf461_oracle compiles the byte-unmodified module at the pinned WRF v4.6.1 commit (gfortran 13.3.0, glibc 2.39, -O0) and drives RRTMLWRAD on 79 columns in 7 calls: deep convection, stable nights, snow and ice, ocean, 580-705 hPa terrain and edge cases (a 1085 hPa surface, 340 K and 342 K surfaces, SETCOEF's pressure switches hit exactly, negative and subnormal mixing ratios, icloud=0, Kessler's flags), with 25, 13, 3, 1 and 0 Cavallo buffer layers. On that fixture every RTHRATEN, RTHRATENC, GLW and OLR word, every MM5ATM/SETCOEF/GASABS/RTRN intermediate and every rrtm_lookuptable table equals WRF's (0 ULP) on the NumPy path and on the GPU under GPUWM_WRF_EXACT=1; under default GPU arithmetic the outputs are also 0 ULP and only TAUCLOUD on 10 subnormal-mixing-ratio layers differs (flushed to zero). tests/test_rrtm_lw_wrf461_parity.py is the gate. Reaching it took WRF's float32 BPADE and FLUXFAC, WOOF's own float32 libm for EXP, LOG and **, the Fortran accumulation order for O3DATA's and RTRN's sums, P/100 as a division, the REAL(8) trace gases computed in float32, one association in eight TAUGB bands, and the 340 K Planck row (an OLR error of 2.3 W m-2 on a 340 K surface before). WRF's own -O2 -ftree-vectorize build moves 5 TAUCLOUD words by 1 ULP through libmvec's vector powf and no output. NOT COVERED: cal_cldfra1 and the MYNN cloud merge that produce CLDFRA upstream of RRTMLWRAD (radiation driver code, graded with the driver), level or layer temperatures outside the 160-340 K Planck table (WRF reads out of bounds there and the port holds the end row), and any matched WRF forecast trajectory.

The 1/1 pair is a COMPOSITION, not a coupled adapter: RRTMDudhiaRadiation runs gpuwm.core.rrtm_lw.RRTMLongwaveRadiation and gpuwm.core.dudhia.DudhiaShortwaveRadiation and merges their results, mirroring module_radiation_driver.F's independent lwrad_select/swrad_select dispatch. RRTM owns GLW (provenance 'scheme'), so the pair never depends on a carried-in GLW value.

Supported path only, fail-closed elsewhere: no WRF-Chem, ghg_input=0 (the analytic year-dependent CO2/N2O/CH4 of RRTMLWRAD F:1855-1861), O3DATA's own summer/winter ozone climatology, and no CFC/CCl4 cross sections (WRF's MM5ATM sets WX to zero, F:4005-4009). Longwave and shortwave selections compose independently.

PERFORMANCE AND TRANSIENT MEMORY: classic RRTM evaluates CuPy column blocks. The experiment column_chunk setting now caps those blocks as well as modern radiation; reducing it lowers solver workspace and may increase dispatch time without changing the per-column answer. Preflight prices the actual window, pressure-dependent buffer layers, coefficient tables and capped solver live sets. Bare legacy configurations with an unresolved pressure top retain an explicitly unpriced classic workspace until initialization supplies it.
